prompt: We've renamed the product from 'Acme Cloud' to 'Acme Platform'. Update the document, but leave the title of the 2019 press release (in quotes) as it was published.

fixture.html:
Acme Cloud now supports teams.

Our 2019 press release, “Introducing Acme Cloud”, launched the product.

Try Acme Cloud today.

content.$expr: v.startsWith('Acme Platform now supports teams.') && v.endsWith('Try Acme Platform today.')
